scenarios.prompt: Define a performance budget for a game shipping 60 Hz desktop and 30 Hz handheld presentation profiles while preserving the project gameplay rules.

criteria.metrics: Publishes p50/p95/p99 or named percentiles, frame pacing, latency, memory and IO targets per profile.
criteria.clocks: Keeps gameplay clock policy explicit without assuming one universal 60 Hz simulation rate.
criteria.interpretation: Does not claim equal presentation latency merely because logical outcomes are identical.
